newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Icos eyes Nasdaq listing - paper.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Icos eyes Nasdaq listing - paper.

text.p: Belgium's Icos plans to list on the U.S. Nasdaq growth stocks market, possibly following that with an Easdaq listing in Brussels, Belgian newspaper L'Echo reported on Thursday.
Details of the listing plan were sketchy but the company's shareholders hoped to raise 1.0-1.5 billion francs, the paper said.

Icos was founded in 1982 as a spin-off from research at Leuven University. Management acquired the company, which makes visual monitoring systems used in the microchip and security industries, with the backing of venture capitalists in 1989.
The company had 1996 profit of 133 million francs on sales of 936 million francs, L'Echo said.
